summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getFullYear in its own file in the spec's order. Step 1-3 go through date::this_time_value(agent, this)?, which should perform RequireInternalSlot and propagate its TypeError with `?`. Step 4 returns NaN when tv is NaN. Step 5 returns Number(year_from_time(local_time(agent, tv))). No test-shaped branches, no hardcoded values, no swallowed errors. The renamed unused parameters (_args, _new_target) are a cosmetic change inside the same file. The helpers in crate::support::date are not part of the diff, so I could not inspect their bodies. I am relying on the gate's passing 8 new test262 results and the absence of any not-implemented path in this file.
